title: 宝塚記念の後に・咲き誇る、青

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Spurred on by the support of her fans, Rice Shower wins the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having made so many people smile, she finally becomes the blue rose she always aspired to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen behind her, she decides to run in the Arima Kinen against Mihono Bourbon and Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Like the Takarazuka Kinen, only racers selected by the fans can run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her state her intention to run in such a prestigious race without a hint of apprehension, I can sense how much Rice Shower has grown.
